scenario_description:
Objective: Have usable paper finding charts ready for Miriam’s committed manual-telescope session at Cienega Creek.
Emerging Need: The future outing changes to an electronics-dark east-field plan, so the selected manual telescope needs the correctly oriented paper chart before departure.
Decision Context: Her field-kit notes identify the reversed optical view and existing incompatible chart sheet. The final target sheet becomes available after the site plan is confirmed and the club printer can make one corrected copy.
Consequence: Without that preparation, Miriam begins the fixed observing slot without a usable chart for the chosen manual setup; she may still observe casually or seek help, but that does not supply the missing preparation at the start.

parameter.title: Cienega Creek dark-sky observing night
parameter.description: Confirmed casual east-field manual-telescope observing session; final target sheet and night-screen arrangements to follow. After-hours entry is already arranged by the site coordinator; no personal gate-roster submission is pending.
parameter.location: Cienega Creek Preserve east pullout, Pima County, AZ

parameter.subject: Cienega east-field target plan still provisional
parameter.body: The Sep 4 east-field target plan is still provisional. Screen restrictions and paper chart files will be confirmed after the group site test; please do not print draft charts because the target order and view orientation may change. After-hours vehicle entry has already been arranged for confirmed participants.

parameter.content: Final Sep 4 plan: the east-field group will use paper charts from 20:30–21:00 so phone and laptop screens stay off. The final chart packet is now posted in two versions, upright binocular view and left-right reversed star-diagonal view. Our desk can print one free A3 sheet per attendee; reply here by Friday Sep 4 at 18:00 with the appropriate version and chart label. No ID or plate is required.

parameter.subject: Final chart print desk open until 18:00
parameter.body: The print desk is running until 18:00. Miriam has no chart copy requested yet. The east-field packet is EastSector-M27 finder; choose upright or left-right reversed according to the personal telescope setup, not the vehicle or membership record. Copies are handed out before departure.

parameter.subject: East-field opening target interval has begun
parameter.body: The 20:30 east-field target interval has begun with the paper-chart setup. Miriam arrived with only her old west-field upright sheet; the print desk closed at 18:00 and no printer is at the site. She cannot start the planned manual M27 chart exercise with that sheet. Casual observing or asking a neighbor for help is still possible; do not turn screens on in the electronics-dark group.
